name: discord-mcp
description: Discord server management MCP for AI agents: chat, moderation, admin, and full server building.
long_description: Discord MCP gives an AI assistant full operational control of a Discord server through your own bot: 164 tools covering chat, moderation, automod, events, and administration, up to building out a complete community server from a one paragraph brief. Destructive actions never execute on the first call; they return a preview first.

discord_token.title: Discord bot token
discord_token.description: From the Discord Developer Portal: your application, Bot page, Reset Token. Turn on all three Privileged Gateway Intents while you are there.

guild.title: Default server id
guild.description: Optional. With it set, tools can omit the server parameter.

read_only.title: Read-only mode
read_only.description: Load only the tools that look things up. Nothing can be sent, changed, or deleted, and scheduled messages wait.

allowed_servers.title: Allowed servers
allowed_servers.description: Optional. Server ids separated by commas. When set, the tools act only in these servers.

files_folder.title: Files folder
files_folder.description: Optional. A folder whose images and sounds can be uploaded as emoji, stickers, sounds, role icons, and server or bot pictures. Nothing else on this computer is read.

usage_stats.title: Usage stats
usage_stats.description: Send a small, anonymous usage report so we can see which features people use and what to improve. Nothing in it identifies you or your servers.
